verdict.reasons: Advisory: Minor visual artifact on the bottom-left edge of the cartons. Core defects: The installed lateral drip tapes are physically impossibly thick and stiff (resembling large polyethylene tubing rather than flat tape); the soil walkway is too dry and compacted to logically support a heavy, large-diameter roll without visible crushing or displacement (the roll is floating in the scene).

focused_physical_review.reason: The white-and-blue AFP package is physically isolated from the irrigation lines with a broad, uninterrupted soil gap visible around its complete footprint. No installed lines touch, cross, or emerge from the carton base. Only the single required package is present; no additional loose coils are visible. The carton surfaces are smooth with no protruding tapes, ribbons, or strips.

acceptance_decision.source: user requested practical >=90 acceptance; actual saved vision evidence retained
